No private 3-star on the hill was found: Booking.com's 'hotels near Tirumala' page for 18-19 Nov 2026 lists only properties in Tirupati (3-star-labelled there: DJ Grand 2624, Nanda Mohan Residency 3623, Manchu Signature Suites 3307, Sudha Brahma 3675, SKYLAR 3780, Treebo HR Grand 9392), which belong to Tirupati's own page, not Tirumala. Kayak shows one private hotel on the hill (Srinivasa Hotel, from 1160 for 17-18 Oct, review score 7.7, n=1), not enough for a median. Pilgrim crowding around Tirumala is year-round; 18-19 Nov is not a named TTD festival date.
